name: probit-f10-p1
description: The capped PROBIT error tree's split forget as the only factor (11-12 ~06:40; analyst 6.70 slot 2: the six should not carry an untested forget on probit while the LR trees carry 10). F-P x2; T-P-Ne capped (limit 4, 1M, noise 0.03) at --forget-factor 1 x2 and at 10 x2. Seed 56, ply 1, games_per_cycle 1584, self-games, plateau scaled min 300, cap 400, hybrid16 games, hybrid6 training. Prediction (6.70): forget 10 within 15 of forget 1 either way (ADF keeps the probit leaves' steps alive, so only the NB routers' counts change); 20+ below keeps forget 1. Read: panel (standing ply-1 panel r + e + g + h at v300), v150 and the final, plies 1 and 2 (models/from-scratch/global11-drafts/probit-f10-read.sh).
